title: plugin-security: the owner-anchor, queue and field-write 403s carry no userMessage, so the console shows its generic "no permission" toast instead of what was refused
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Filing gate: ④ per-layer child of #32169 (p2, filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」 after the 2026-11-10 platform test run #32135). Split by the seat on the card thread's phase-1 report, measured on a live showcase at `origin/main` `bb472154` (report: `/mnt/project-files/server-orders/seat2/32169-phase1-report.md`, project files).
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat that claims it.

## What happens

On `main` the owner-anchor 403 already names `owner_id` at the wire (183–187 chars of developer prose naming internal grants, e.g. "requires the transfer grant (allowTransfer or modifyAllRecords)"). The console (`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts`, #3821) replaces every `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with its own generic toast unless the error carries `userMessage`, so a console user never learns what was refused. The nameless object-level 403 is ruled nameless (#7414 / #7451) and is not in scope.

Sites: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` `denyOwnerWrite` / `denyOwnershipChange` / `denyQueueWrite` (~L1544-1565) and the step-2.5 field-write throw (~L1353). `mapDataError` already relays a thrown `userMessage` (`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` ~L601), so no transport change is needed.

## Expected

Keep `code`, status and `message`. Add a short, static, localized `userMessage` to those throws (owner change, create-for-someone-else, disown, queue; field write: field labels, never API names, or no field named, per #7414). The strings are new keys in the spec operation-message catalog (`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`, its locales).

Also measure and decide here (side finding of the same run): a forged `created_by` or `owning_business_unit_id` on create is re-stamped/dropped silently with no `droppedFields` row, unlike `organization_id` (`droppedFields: [{fields:['organization_id'], reason:'readonly'}]`). No access widens; it is an honesty gap.

Clause-②: yes (widening): a new member on an existing 403 envelope (and, if taken, a new `droppedFields` row). Metadata-protocol: none.
Business reason: console users and admins see why a save was refused instead of a vague denial.
